_comment: What the WEBSITE carries. Each file is an asset of the map-data GitHub Release, pinned by size and sha256, and laid under the build's own assets/ folder at `path`, the stable name the site asks for (src/runtime/assetsBase.js). scripts/stage-map-assets.mjs downloads and verifies them into map-cache/; `npm run build:web` and `build:site` lay them into dist-web/. It is the desktop's list (scripts/map-assets.json) cut to what a browser can hold: the z8 archives (the map mounts them at maxzoom 8) and the web-sized world, deep-cleaned, with the stock world's owners as country names. Every file must stay under Cloudflare Pages' 25 MiB a file (SITE_FILE_LIMIT_BYTES in the stager). A browser cannot fetch a release asset itself (GitHub sends no CORS header on the download), which is why the site carries its copy instead of asking for one.
